source: This framework is more durable than memorizing a linear evolution from ZXNAME0000XZ to ZXNAME0001XZ to ZXNAME0002XZ to ZXNAME0003XZ. Architectures do not evolve on one axis. They trade representation capacity, memory footprint, bandwidth, arithmetic, and implementation complexity in different combinations.
zh: 该框架比记住从 ZXNAME0000XZ 到 ZXNAME0001XZ 到 ZXNAME0002XZ 到 ZXNAME0003XZ 的线性演变更持久。架构不会沿着一个轴发展。它们以不同的组合来交换表示容量、内存占用、带宽、算术和实现复杂性。
